arxiv-2108-01077.title: Generating Master Faces for Dictionary Attacks with a Network-Assisted Latent Space Evolution
arxiv-2108-01077.creator: Ron Shmelkin, Tomer Friedlander and Lior Wolf The Blavatnik School of Computer Science, Tel Aviv University The School of Electrical Engineering, Tel Aviv University
arxiv-2108-01077.description: Abstract A master face is a face image that passes face-based identity-authentication for a large portion of the population. These faces can be used to impersonate, with a high probability of success, any user, without having access to any user-information. We optimize these faces, by using an evolutionary algorithm in the latent embedding space of the StyleGAN face generator.

arxiv-2309-02123.title: Persisting quantum effects in the anisotropic Rabi model at thermal equilibrium
arxiv-2309-02123.creator: He-Guang Xu, V. Montenegro, Gao Xianlong, Jiasen Jin, G. D. de Moraes Neto
arxiv-2309-02123.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by He-Guang Xu, V. Montenegro, Gao Xianlong, Jiasen Jin, G. D. de Moraes Neto. Quantum correlations and nonclassical states are at the heart of emerging quantum technologies. Efforts to produce long-lived states of such quantum resources are a subject of tireless pursuit. Among several platforms useful for quantum technology, the mature quantum system of light-matter interactions offers unprecedented advantages due to current on-chip nanofabrication, efficient quantum control of its constituents, and its wide range of operational regimes.

arxiv-2403-02423.title: Percolation of nonequilibrium assemblies of colloidal particles in active chiral liquids
arxiv-2403-02423.creator: Pragya Kushwaha 1 , Sayan Maity 1 , Anjaly S. Menon 2 , Raghunath Chelakkot 3 , Vijayakumar Chikkadi 1
arxiv-2403-02423.description: Abstract The growing interest in the non-equilibrium assembly of colloidal particles in active liquids is driven by the motivation to create novel structures endowed with tunable properties unattainable within the confines of equilibrium systems. Here, we present an experimental investigation of the structural features of colloidal assemblies in active liquids of chiral E. coli.

arxiv-2505-19752.title: Discrete Markov Bridge
arxiv-2505-19752.creator: Hengli Li lihengli@stu.pku.edu.cn, Yuxuan Wang wangyuxuan1@bigai.ai, Song-Chun Zhu s.c.zhu@pku.edu.cn, Ying Nian Wu ywu@stat.ucla.edu, Zilong Zheng zlzheng@bigai.ai
arxiv-2505-19752.description: Abstract Discrete diffusion has recently emerged as a promising paradigm in discrete data modeling. However, existing methods typically rely on a fixed-rate transition matrix during training, which not only limits the expressiveness of latent representations—a fundamental strength of variational methods—but also constrains the overall design space.

arxiv-2510-22716.title: LRW-Persian: Lip-reading in the Wild Dataset for Persian Language
arxiv-2510-22716.creator: Zahra Taghizadeh, Mohammad Shahverdikondori, Arian Noori, Alireza Dadgarnia
arxiv-2510-22716.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zahra Taghizadeh, Mohammad Shahverdikondori, Arian Noori, Alireza Dadgarnia. Lipreading has emerged as an increasingly important research area for developing robust speech recognition systems and assistive technologies for the hearing-impaired. However, non-English resources for visual speech recognition remain limited. We introduce LRW-Persian , the largest in-the-wild Persian word-level lipreading dataset, comprising 743 743 target words and over 414,000 414{,}000 video samples extracted from more than 1,900 1{,}900 hours of footage across 67 67 television programs.

arxiv-2511-06650.title: Polynomial extensions of Raimi’s theorem
arxiv-2511-06650.creator: Norbert Hegyvári, János Pach, Thang Pham
arxiv-2511-06650.description: Abstract Raimi’s theorem guarantees the existence of a partition of ℕ \mathbb{N} into two parts with an unavoidable intersection property: for any finite coloring of ℕ \mathbb{N} , some color class intersects both parts infinitely many times, after an appropriate shift (translation).

arxiv-2601-18918.title: Center Manifolds and Normal Forms for Nonlinearly Periodically Forced DDEs
arxiv-2601-18918.creator: Bram Lentjes, Seppe Daniëls, Meinder Follon, Yuri A. Kuznetsov
arxiv-2601-18918.description: Abstract The aim of this paper is to provide an effective framework for analysing bifurcations of equilibria in nonlinearly periodically forced delay differential equations. First, we establish the existence of a periodic smooth finite-dimensional center manifold near a nonhyperbolic equilibrium using the rigorous functional analytic framework of dual semigroups (sun-star calculus).

arxiv-2602-12748.creator: Tobias Labarta, Nhi Hoang, Maximilian Dreyer, Jim Berend, Oleg Hein, Jackie Ma, Wojciech Samek, Sebastian Lapuschkin
arxiv-2602-12748.description: Abstract The explainable AI (XAI) research community has proposed numerous technical methods, yet deploying explainability as systems remains challenging: Interactive explanation systems require both suitable algorithms and system capabilities that maintain explanation usability across repeated queries, evolving models and data, and governance constraints.

pmc-11382204.title: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier regulates adipose glucose partitioning in female mice
pmc-11382204.creator: Christopher E. Shannon, Terry Bakewell, Marcel J. Fourcaudot, Iriscilla Ayala, Annie A. Smelter, Edgar A. Hinostroza, Giovanna Romero, Mara Asmis, Leandro C. Freitas Lima, Martina Wallace, Luke Norton
pmc-11382204.description: ObjectiveThe mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) occupies a critical node in intermediary metabolism, prompting interest in its utility as a therapeutic target for the treatment of obesity and cardiometabolic disease. Dysregulated nutrient metabolism in adipose tissue is a prominent feature of obesity pathophysiology, yet the functional role of adipose MPC has not been explored.

pmc-11607921.title: Medical students’ perceptions of a community-engaged learning approach to community health in Ghana: the Students’ Community Engagement Programme (SCEP)
pmc-11607921.creator: Gifty Dufie Ampofo, Joseph Osarfo, Harry Kwami Tagbor
pmc-11607921.description: BackgroundRevitalizing primary health care requires that the health workforce, especially doctors, must appreciate the significance of the socio-cultural environment in health. To achieve this objective, training of medical students must emphasize greater understanding of the community and its role in health through community engagement using community-engaged learning.

pmc-12376363.title: Anti-thyroglobulin antibody levels post-thyroidectomy and papillary thyroid carcinoma recurrence
pmc-12376363.creator: Ho Jung Jeong, Jin Seok Lee, Jun Sung Lee, Hyeok Jun Yun, Hojin Chang, Seok Mo Kim, Yong Sang Lee, Hang-Seok Chang
pmc-12376363.description: BackgroundThe global incidence of thyroid cancer, particularly papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC), is rising due to more frequent incidental findings. Despite a high 10-year survival rate of 93%, up to 28% of PTC patients experience locoregional recurrence. Postoperative monitoring typically relies on serum thyroglobulin (Tg), but the presence of anti-thyroglobulin antibodies (TgAb) interferes with Tg measurement, necessitating reliable detection methods.

pmc-12663003.title: Targeted degradation of KRAS and induction of bystander effects by a modular bioPROTAC
pmc-12663003.creator: Shojiro Inano, Akifumi Takaori-Kondo, Takako Nakajima
pmc-12663003.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Targeted protein degradation is a promising strategy for addressing oncogenic drivers that are difficult to inhibit with small molecules, such as KRAS. While bioPROTACs expand the range of targetable proteins, their clinical translation is limited by inefficient delivery. To overcome this barrier, we engineered a chimeric protein, termed DEG-KRAS, which consists of a KRAS-binding domain derived from CRAF (RBD/CRD), an E3 adaptor (WSB1), and an optional trafficking module.

pmc-13156278.title: A new approach for improving access to primary care and public health in India: the 3T Model
pmc-13156278.creator: Satadal Saha, Bibaswan Basu, Ruchira Mukherjee
pmc-13156278.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). A health system strengthening (HSS) approach through an innovative 3T-model can solve this ubiquitous problem.

pmc-13575112.title: Value of preoperative peripheral blood inflammation markers in predicting prognosis after radical gastric cancer surgery
pmc-13575112.creator: Xiang Li, Wei Dai, Feng Wen, Jinming Xu, Ke Li, LianWei Wang, Yajun Chen, Zhongxue Fu, Jun Zhang
pmc-13575112.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We aimed to systematically investigate the association between ten preoperative peripheral blood inflammatory markers and the clinicopathologic characteristics and outcomes of gastric cancer (GC) and develop a prediction model for overall survival (OS) based on these markers. We conducted retrospective analyses of the clinicopathological data of 921 patients with gastric cancer who underwent radical gastrectomy, adjusting baseline characteristics using propensity score matching (PSM).

pmc-13653355.creator: Juan J. Huaroto, Gert‐willem Römer, Ivo M. Vellekoop, Sarthak Misra
pmc-13653355.description: Magnetic microrobotics holds promise for minimally invasive biomedical applications, yet imaging in this field still relies predominantly on external modalities.
